name: Penfluridol
summary: Penfluridol (Semap, Micefal, Longoperidol) is a highly potent, first generation diphenylbutylpiperidine antipsychotic. It was discovered at Janssen Pharmaceutica in 1968. Related to other diphenylbutylpiperidine antipsychotics, pimozide and fluspirilene, penfluridol has an extremely long elimination half-life and its effects last for many days after single oral dose.

pharmacology.text: Its antipsychotic potency, in terms of dose needed to produce comparable effects, is similar to both haloperidol and pimozide.

uses.text: Penfluridol is indicated for antipsychotic treatment of chronic schizophrenia and similar psychotic disorders, it is, however, like most typical antipsychotics, being increasingly replaced by the atypical antipsychotics. Due to its extremely long-lasting effects, it is often prescribed to be taken orally as tablets only once a week (q 7 days).

summaryZh: 五氟利多 （英語：Penfluridol） 是一種強效的典型抗精神病藥，屬於 吩噻嗪類 (英語：Phenothiazine) 藥物 。該藥於 1968 年由楊森製藥公司發現。五氟利多的消除半衰期極長，單次口服後藥效可持續數天。就產生類似效果所需劑量而言，其抗精神病效力與氟哌啶醇和匹莫齊特相似。

sideEffects.en: Like other older antipsychotics it commonly causes stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, which is lasting involuntary movements. Antipsychotics carry a rare risk of a severe reaction with fever and muscle rigidity.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他舊式抗精神病藥一樣，它常造成肌肉僵硬、顫抖與躁動不安，長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，也就是持久的不自主動作。抗精神病藥有罕見但嚴重的反應風險，會出現發燒與肌肉僵硬。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他旧式抗精神病药一样，它常造成肌肉僵硬、颤抖与躁动不安，长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，也就是持久的不自主动作。抗精神病药有罕见但严重的反应风险，会出现发烧与肌肉僵硬。

fact.en: It was discovered at Janssen in 1968 and is so long lasting that it was given as a tablet taken once a week, which was unusual for an antipsychotic.
fact.zh: 它在 1968 年由楊森公司發現，作用極為持久，因此採用每週服用一次的錠劑形式，這在抗精神病藥中相當少見。
fact.zhHans: 它在 1968 年由杨森公司发现，作用极为持久，因此采用每周服用一次的锭剂形式，这在抗精神病药中相当少见。
